foundations.statement: Every finite extension of a perfectoid field is perfectoid. The actual field E_L is proved to equal the finite compositum LE_0 inside C.
Original P/AI, actual Good/GamS/WSer/IoS/IoW and finite integral lattices; no new compatibility between outer layers.
Cyclotomic Eisenstein polynomials, finite extensions of complete valued fields, Krull topology, finite free bases, Witt vector completeness and determinant/tensor algebra; limiting steps are printed.
WIS/IFD/WPR precise inputs listed with exact proof hashes in inherited_inputs.json.
